restartBody: Tally Stick needs to restart to change text direction. Saved drafts will be kept.
changeFailed: Language could not be changed. Please try again.
theJsonFileIsInTheFolderYouChose: The JSON file is in the folder you chose.
sharedChangesInvitationsFriendRequestsAn: Shared changes, invitations, friend requests and reminders will appear here.
pushNotificationsRequireATallyStickBuild: Push notifications require a Tally Stick build linked to Expo on a physical device.
allowNotificationsInYourDeviceSettingsTo: Allow notifications in your device settings to turn on push notifications.
everyDeviceWillBeSignedOut: Every device will be signed out
changingYourPasswordEndsEverySessionIncl: Changing your password ends every session, including this one. You will return to Sign in.
atLeast12CharactersLongerBeatsComplicate: At least 12 characters. Longer beats complicated.
theTwoNewPasswordsDoNotMatch: The two new passwords do not match.
thisIsPermanentYourProfileIsAnonymizedAn: This is permanent. Your profile is anonymized and every device is signed out. Financial history remains for audit.
deletionReviewBalances: You have open balances. Settle them here to continue.
deletionReviewGroups: You're still in active groups. Your balances in them are settled, so you can leave them here.
deletionReviewBoth: You have open balances and active groups. Settle and leave them here to continue.
groupWillArchive: You're the last member, so it will be archived
settlingOnlyRecords: Settling here only records that these debts were paid outside Tally Stick. No money moves. Everyone involved is notified and sees the records in Activity.
leavingGroupsNote: Other members see that you left in Activity. A group you leave last is archived, not deleted.
nothingToSettle: Nothing to settle. You have no open balances or groups.
summaryAnonymize: Anonymize your profile. Financial history stays for audit.
deletionConfirmWithPlan: This is permanent. Tally Stick records the settlements you reviewed, removes you from your groups, anonymizes your profile and signs out every device.
recordingAndDeleting: Recording settlements and deleting your account
balancesChangedBody: Something changed in your balances or groups while you were reviewing. Nothing was recorded and your account wasn't deleted.
couldntCheckDeletion: Couldn't check what's left to settle.
accountDeletedBody: Your Tally Stick account was deleted and every device was signed out.
thisSignsOutOnlyThisDevice: This signs out only this device.
receiveTallyStickAlertsOnThisDevice: Receive Tally Stick alerts on this device.
manualRemindersFromPeopleYouOwe: Manual reminders from people you owe.
theseChooseWhichAlertsPushSendsTheInboxS: These choose which alerts push sends. The inbox shows everything.
thisStopsPushAlertsOnThisInstallationOth: This stops push alerts on this installation. Other devices remain unchanged.
pushIsntAvailableInThisVersionOfTallySti: Push isn't available in this version of Tally Stick. Your inbox still gets every update.
yourProfileAndDefaultsAreUpToDate: Your profile and defaults are up to date.
everyoneYouShareALedgerWithSeesThisName: Everyone you share a ledger with sees this name.
changingYourEmailIsNotSupportedInThisVer: Changing your email is not supported in this version.
displayCurrencyChangesTheSymbolTallyStic: Display currency changes the symbol Tally Stick uses for amounts. It does not convert stored values. Profile photos are not supported; initials are generated from your name.
thatDeviceWillNeedToSignInAgain: That device will need to sign in again.
everyOtherDeviceWillNeedToSignInAgain: Every other device will need to sign in again.
exportFolder: Save a JSON snapshot of your profile, social state, financial history, activity, reminders, and notifications. You’ll choose a folder to save it.
exportShare: Save a JSON snapshot of your profile, social state, financial history, activity, reminders, and notifications. You’ll choose where to save or send it.
turnOnNotificationsBody: Get alerts when someone adds an expense, records a settlement, invites you or sends a reminder. You can change this anytime in Account.
